title: Transport of an exact pairing along two isomorphisms
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\otimes,\mathbf1)$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Let $U,D$ be objects with maps $\eta:\mathbf1\to U\otimes D$ and $\varepsilon:D\otimes U\to\mathbf1$ satisfying the two triangle identities
$$(1_U\otimes\varepsilon)\circ(\eta\otimes1_U)=1_U,\qquad(\varepsilon\otimes1_D)\circ(1_D\otimes\eta)=1_D,$$
where canonical associators and unitors are inserted. Given objects $V,E$ and isomorphisms $w:U\xrightarrow{\sim}V$ and $z:E\xrightarrow{\sim}D$, put
$$\eta'=(w\otimes z^{-1})\circ\eta,\qquad\varepsilon'=\varepsilon\circ(z\otimes w^{-1}).$$
Then $\eta':\mathbf1\to V\otimes E$ and $\varepsilon':E\otimes V\to\mathbf1$ satisfy both triangle identities for $V,E$. No braiding is required.

source.place: Final two sentences: the triangle identities remain valid when the duality maps are transported along an isomorphism.
